correctness.rationale: Complete feedback-state bijection covers all 65,536 tables and selects exactly 2,048 single-orbit cycles; independent Hierholzer enumeration yields precisely the same 2,048 canonical words. The proven dynamic recurrence for distinct scattered-subsequence sets agrees bit-for-bit with definition-level earliest-match testing at k=8..14 for all cycles. Exact grouping gives classes 1,1,21,629,1520,2016,2048; 32 13-deck doubletons and 1,984 singletons. All 13-pairs satisfy XOR=5*2^t. A sample pair is directly verified. The extension lemma proves sharpness and prevents an unverified extrapolation.

value.rationale: The smallest distinguishing scattered-subsequence deck length for a natural canonical family is a motivated exact invariant in string reconstruction and Simon congruence. Its sharp value 14 improves on the general length-32 sufficient bound 17, while the 32 precise ambiguity pairs and their local-swap geometry explain failures just below threshold. This is a complete natural finite benchmark for the first large binary de Bruijn family, not an arbitrary data slice.
